reason: No confirmatory outcome is ROBUST or MODERATELY ROBUST in the protective direction; separations are an informative null, other labor outcomes are underpowered, and the only consistent business signs are adverse and fail multiple testing. The original county-level labor/business resilience paper is therefore NO-GO in its current form. However, an economically large and specification-robust reduction in reported tornado damage per EF step in mitigated counties (about -42% to -60%) exists, while its identification fails the pre-treatment placebo (selection on damage) and relies on a damage-based intensity measure. This matches GO WITH REDESIGN: an interesting result whose identification (exposure measured independently of damage, sub-county matching, applicant or HMGP-ceiling comparisons, completion timing) must be improved. Not PILOT ONLY, because the data are already fully assembled and the remaining problem is identification, not instability.
